data.description: Front-end development for the My Account area of El Corte Inglés' ecommerce (Vue, SSR and accessibility). I also designed and evolved the agentic harness that the development team uses daily: an orchestrator with specialised subagents and skills on GitHub Copilot CLI covering the full cycle from user story to PR, with human approval and optimised for token spend management.

data.position: Senior Front-End Developer at NyxellApp S.L.
data.description: I led the development of the back-office for a nightlife ticketing marketplace (events, venues and customer management), including the migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3, with a focus on improving the interface and usability. Vue, Sass, Node.js, Vite and AWS Amplify.

data.position: Agile Front-End Developer at Trackglobe S.L.
data.description: Development and maintenance of custom modules with Vue and Sass within a .NET MVC platform on Azure, and integration of HTML5, Sass and JavaScript mock-ups into the group's projects.
Custom software development with C#, .NET MVC and MySQL, including database schema design and maintenance, and research into Microsoft mobile solutions on Office 365 (PowerApps).
Hardware assembly and maintenance, backups and technical support at a HiperCor store (El Corte Inglés Group). My first professional experience and the foundation of how I solve problems.

aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.description1: I'm a front-end developer with a passion for product: understanding the people who use it and caring about every detail of the experience. Today AI is at the heart of how I work: I design agentic harnesses for teams, orchestrate subagents, look after the context window and token costs, and closely follow every new model and tool to keep what truly works.
aboutMe.description2: With Andalusian roots, I was born in Jerez and grew up in Seville, which I visit less often than I'd like. I currently live in Valencia with my partner, and wherever I go, my laptop always comes with me.
aboutMe.description3: Ever since I was a child I've been fascinated by any device with a screen, a curiosity that over time became a vocation and then my professional career. Today I have the privilege of doing what I love most: building digital experiences and bringing ideas to life through code.
